segments.name: How Mine
segments.description: Underground gold mine in Zimbabwe and the company's only currently producing mine.
segments.evidence: Our How Mine is an established, underground gold mine with a strong track record of operations having produced an aggregate of approximately 1.84Moz of gold from 1941 through December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Mazowe Mine
segments.description: Historically producing gold mine in Zimbabwe on care and maintenance, with preparatory work underway to restart operations.
segments.evidence: In order to unlock this resource potential, we have begun preparatory work to restart operations at the Mazowe Mine.

segments.name: Redwing Mine
segments.description: Historically producing gold mine near Mutare, Zimbabwe, on care and maintenance, with preparatory work underway to restart operations.
segments.evidence: The Redwing Mine is the largest mine in our portfolio and is located 20km North-Northeast of Mutare, Zimbabwe.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling gold extracted from the How Mine.
revenueModel.evidence: Our royalties expense decreased by $0.1 million, or 3%, to $4.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, from $4.3 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, in line with our sales of gold extracted from How Mine.

changes.text: For the year ended 2024, the segment report was disaggregated further under an IFRIC Agenda Decision and the comparatives were restated.
changes.evidence: As a result, the comparatives for the year ended December 31, 2024 have also been disaggregated further and restated.
